summary.text: Jessica Harper is the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 93 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jason Stephens.
She is a high school teacher of American Government.

paragraphs.text: Harper graduated from Wellston High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 2004, and holds a graduate degree from Ohio University, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has taught for ten years and is president of her local teachers' union and a member of the Ohio Education Association Board of Directors.
She said she would redirect EdChoice voucher funds to public schools, oppose data center construction on agricultural land in the district, and prioritize transparency.
